gaps.roster_source: MLB Stats API 2026 Mexican League season. Players who did not appear are not in the feed.
gaps.bats_throws: The season feed has no bats or throws, so those stay blank.
gaps.pitch_mix: No pitch-type mix, velocity, or plate location in this feed. Usage charts and heat maps stay empty.
gaps.platoon: No vs-L / vs-R split. Both hands repeat the 2026 season line.
gaps.two_way: A player in both files is a pitcher when batters faced are at least his plate appearances.
